toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Search1API provides web, maps, and news search alongside crawling, screenshots, sitemap discovery, and structured data extraction for AI agents.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: Connection is active and ready to use

SEARCH1API_SEARCH_WEB.description: Search the web for one or more queries and return a typed outcome for each. Each query has a base cost of 1 credit plus 1 credit for each result page successfully fetched through crawl_results. The page field selects one native provider page only for Bing, Bing China, Baidu, and Grokipedia; this tool does not auto-paginate.

page.description: Native result page (1-100). Only bing, bingcn, baidu, and grokipedia honor values after 1; other engines ignore it.

image.description: Whether to include image results when supported.

query.description: Search query to send to the selected web engine.

language.description: Language code such as en, zh-CN, or fr; Search1API has no separate region parameter.

time_range.description: Optional publication-age filter; the official schema also permits an empty string.

crawl_results.description: Number of top result pages whose full text to fetch (0-50 and no greater than max_results). Each successfully fetched page adds 1 credit to the base 1-credit search.

exclude_sites.description: Site or domain filters to exclude from the search.

include_sites.description: Site or domain filters to include in the search.

search_service.description: Native search engine. Omit for Google; the official schema also permits an empty string.

requests.description: One or more web search queries. Each item is billed at a base cost of 1 credit plus 1 credit for each result page successfully fetched through crawl_results.

SEARCH1API_CRAWL_URLS.description: Fetch readable content from one or more public URLs. Search1API charges 1 credit for each successful item; a target 404 or 410 is a completed, charged lookup. Batch successes may be unordered, and failed items may be omitted.

enable_fallback.description: Whether Search1API may use its fallback crawler for this URL.

requests.description: URLs to crawl. Use one item for one URL. Search1API charges 1 credit for each successful item.

SEARCH1API_ASK_RESEARCH.description: Run a natural-language research query across up to five provider-selected engines and return at most 10 deduplicated, reranked results plus partial source errors. Warning: each completed call costs 5 credits.

examples: What are developers saying about Bun 1.3 this month?
